author: bardic-inspiration
name: Bannerstaff of the Last Line
summary: A quarterstaff that bolsters nearby allies with courage.
description: A tattered banner is bound around the grip, and no one agrees on which army it first flew over. Soldiers touch it before they march.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can plant the staff's end in the ground. Allies within 30 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws against the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the start of your next turn.
